title: Blood Runs Deep
start: Talk to Baba Yaga on Lunar Isle.

items.t: Weapons for the Melee, Ranged and Magic combat styles
All four elemental spells: Blast, Wave, or Surge spells recommended

recommended.t: Armour that provides minimal penalties to Ranged or Magic but still has good defensive properties. Hybrid armour is recommended because style switching is required

rewards.t: The Balmung, a two-handed melee weapon with special passive abilities when used against dagannoths (enhanced through the Koschei's Troubles miniquest);
25% (45%) extra damage with auto attacks (15% (35%) against Dagannoth Supreme)
12.5% (22.5%) extra damage with with abilities (7.5% (17.5%) against Dagannoth Supreme)

450000 Combat XP (3x 150000 Combat XP) in either scl | Attack , scl | Defence , scl | Strength , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic or scl | Prayer (Skill must be level 75 or higher; speak to Chieftain Brundt to receive this)
Both the Dagannoth Mother and her sentinels can be faced in the Dominion Tower

steps.t: Talk to Baba Yaga on Lunar Isle about the man in the bed. [Chat: 1 Talk about the man in the bed. › Accept › 1 Is there anything we can do? › 1 Yes? › 1 An excellent idea!]
p: In Silas's dream at the lighthouse

steps.t: Talk to Baba Yaga again to go to the Dream World. [Chat: 1 Talk about the man in the bed. › 1 I am ready. › 1 I've no idea. › 1 I think I've got it.]
Listen Silas. [Chat: 1 He's crazy.]
Search the bookcase to obtain a prophecy tablet.
Climb the stairs.
Eavesdrop-on Silas and continue through the tunnel. [Chat: 1 She didn't count on us finding out.]
Talk to Silas. [Chat: 1 I'm a friend of your nephew.]
Read Our Lives. [Chat: 1 What do you mean, 'not working'?]

sub.t: Prepare to face multiple (4-7) Dagannoth and Wallasalki at a time. This will go on for a few minutes.
Do not use your dwarf multicannon in this area or you will lose it.

steps.t: Talk to Baba Yaga to be teleported to Rellekka. [Chat: 1 Talk about the man in the bed. › 1 What is? › 2 I'm ready. What's your trick?]
After killing sufficient Dagannoth, Brundt the Chieftain will command you to get onto his boat.
Talk to Queen Sigrid. [Chat: 1 What is the matter, Your Majesty? › 1 I'll set out right away.]
Talk to Brundt to get another seal of passage. [Chat: 2 I'll go with you.]
p: The Fremennik fight to keep the "daggermouths" from overrunning Rellekka.

steps.t: Bank before teleporting to Waterbirth. Bring prayer potions and a full load of food. Leave 1 space empty.
p: The dagannoth army, marching past the Dagannoth Mother.

steps.t: Talk to Jarvald (on the western pier) and select the option Travel-Waterbirth to head to Waterbirth Island. If he says he's not taking you, you will have to talk to him first and get to the option where you ask "Can I come?"
Talk to Bardur near the cave entrance for a rope. [Chat: 1 What kind of voices? › 1 Could it be an old man echoing from underground?]
Make your way to the southwestern tip of the island and tie the rope on the hole.
Climb-down the hole.
Talk to King Vargas. [Chat: 1 We aren't out yet. › 1 Come on, this isn't the King Vargas I'm used to. › 1 No, I can imagine. › 1 Certainly, I've got some here.]
Lead King Vargas down the path to the north-east and go down the ladder.

sub.t: Don't get too far ahead of King Vargas in the tunnels, or the dagannoth will get him and return him to the first chamber meaning you will have to start over. Staying close to King Vargas also ensures he will not be attacked so you won't have to feed him any food. It's recommended to turn off run while escorting King Vargas.

steps.t: Continue to the far-east side of the next tunnel, past the small obelisk, and climb up the ladder.
The next ladder to climb up is to the west, in this short tunnel dagannoth will spawn that prioritise attacking King Vargas, make sure you attack them so they will focus their attacks on you instead.
Make your way through the last two short tunnels with rock lobsters and climb up the ladder. [Chat: 1 Well, as quickly as you can, please. › 1 Don't touch anything!]
Talk to Eir. [Chat: 1 Pardon? › 1 I'm not supposed to be here? › 1 Can you at least explain where I am? › 1 How do I get back then?]
Talk to Nial Swiftfling. [Chat: 1 [Say nothing] › 1 The dagannoths are mounting a massive attack on nearby settlements. › 1 It's nothing I can't handle.]
Talk to Asleif Hamalsdotter. [Chat: 1 Just passing through. › 1 You realise they're waiting for a huge battle? › 1 I don't recall that working out so well last time.]
p: Marrying King Vargas and Queen Sigrid

steps.t: Talk to Eir. [Chat: 1 Yes, please.]

sub.t: If the spiritual realm sequence is interrupted, speak with Brundt in the long hall in Rellekka to obtain a letter. Read the letter to return.

steps.t: Speak to Brundt the Chieftain. [Chat: Any]
Talk to King Vargas. [Chat: Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any › 2 [Cut to the chase]]
Talk to Princess Astrid or Prince Brand. [Chat: Any]
p: Leading the party of Princess Astrid, Koschei the Deathless, Baba Yaga and Prince Brand.

steps.t: Talk to Brundt to continue and bank. [Chat: 2 Actually, could you drop me off at the bank on Etceteria?]

sub.t: Prepare for a fight with Dagannoth sentinels and the Dagannoth Mother.

steps.t: Talk to Brundt in the long hall in Rellekka when you are ready. [Chat: 2 Ask about the war against the daggermouths. › 1 Yes, let's go now.]
Talk to Baba Yaga on the boat. [Chat: 1 [Say nothing] › 2 What do you think? › 1 Yes, I have. › 1 No, of course not! › 1 I'm ready.]
Climb down the hole on the southwestern tip of the island.
Enter the southern tunnel. [Chat: 1 That sounds reasonable.]
Enter the next tunnel to fight the Dagannoth sentinels. [Chat: 1 Good luck.]

sub.t: After defeating the sentinels, you can go to bank to get more food. You don't need to fight the sentinels again. Also you don't need the tablets or the seal of passage for the fights (saves you a few slots for food).

steps.t: Continue to the next tunnel.
Go to the south-east intersection and enter the tunnel entrance.

sub.t: Use the picture on the right for reference.

steps.t: Proceed south and enter the tunnel.
Go through the next tunnel and select either chat option. [Chat: Any]
Start the battle with Balmung (the special weapon you received from Brundt) and kill the Dagannoth Mother, switching styles according to her colour.

sub.t: If you have trouble telling between the colours (specially red/orange/yellow), you can use the chatbox. It will say "The dagannoth changes to red..." etc.

p: The path through the dungeon, starting from the top left and going to the upper right
Don't let Vargas get behind too much
Eir waits for you in front of "the grand hall of our Father"
You can use a safe spot to take a breath and heal. The mother does not change colours while she is not in combat.
The dagannoth mother, in her chamber.
Dagannoth Mother weak to Air spells

steps.t: After the Dagannoth Mother has been defeated, go back to the previous room, collect the pickaxe, plank, and tinderbox and use them to collapse one of the pillars.
p: The mother has sent her spawn!

steps.t: Talk to Eir. [Chat: 1 I seem to have died again. › 1 Yes, I am.]
Check the bodies and finish chat. [Chat: Any]
p: A black day in Miscellanian history.

steps.t: Talk with Baba Yaga and Koschei.
Attempt to climb up the rope. [Chat: Any › Any]
p: Follow the red line. You need to climb over some obstruction, go west for a bit, enter the tunnel inside the wall (takes you to the other side) and then go south.

steps.t: Quest complete!
Speak to Brundt to receive your reward. [Chat: 2 Ask about the war against the daggermouths.]
